title: Para-Agent Client Adapter Schema
description: Defines the canonical structure for adapter declarations that map client-native event streams and transcript rows into the canonical para-agent exchange model.

schema_version.description: The major persisted shape version represented by this schema.

display_name.description: Human-readable label for the client, e.g. 'Claude Code', 'OpenAI Codex', 'Antigravity CLI'.

version_constraint.description: Optional semver pattern or version string supported by this adapter.

provenance_mappings.description: Property paths or extraction rules for top-level turn/session provenance.

thread_id.description: Path or field name for the conversation/thread identifier.

turn_id.description: Path or field name for the turn identifier.

model.description: Path or field name for the model identifier.

effort.description: Path or field name for reasoning/thinking effort level.

user_label.description: Path or field name for user display name or handle.

record_mappings.description: Declarative rules mapping native client event types to canonical record kinds.

prompt.description: Mapping for ingress user/primary prompt events.

thinking.description: Mapping for internal model reasoning/thinking trace events.

tool_call.description: Mapping for tool invocations and execution responses.

response.description: Mapping for terminal assistant/receiver output responses.

native_type.description: Native event discriminator value or regex.

text_path.description: Path to extract the primary text payload.

timestamp_path.description: Path to extract event timestamp (ISO 8601 string).

phase_path.description: Optional path for multi-phase response events (e.g. 'commentary', 'final').

native_type.description: Native event discriminator value for tool calls.

tool_kind_path.description: Path to extract tool category or kind.

tool_use_id_path.description: Path to extract unique tool call / invocation ID.

input_path.description: Path to extract tool input arguments/payload.

result_path.description: Path to extract tool result or response object.

status_path.description: Path to extract execution status ('completed', 'failed', etc.).
